questions.question: How does Micah 7 describe the prophet's hope amid corruption?
options: He will gather a great army together to defend the whole land
He will look to the LORD and wait for the God of his salvation
He will offer up many sacrifices upon all of the high places
He will flee away to the high mountains in search of safety
questions.answer: He will look to the LORD and wait for the God of his salvation

questions.question: What does Micah marvel at concerning God at the book's end?
options: That he hides away his face entirely from the sinful nation
That he scatters all of the people abroad among the nations
That he repays each and every one according to his own deeds
That he pardons iniquity and delights in steadfast love
questions.answer: That he pardons iniquity and delights in steadfast love
